name: Nowhere Fast: On the Horizon
source:
The sun is rising...

Angel has been on the road for a while. Long drives and making her lonely way in the world are second nature to her. What's new is her growing thirst for blood and the distant threat of immortality. Now, morning brings more than just the light of a new day - with it comes a sense of dread that she just can't shake.

While contending with fears for her future, Angel has an unexpected encounter at a highway gas station with a fiery stranger caught up in her own troubles - and this chance encounter may just set Angel on a new path entirely.

[From [url=https://docilesmiles.itch.io/on-the-horizon]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
太阳正在升起……

天使已经上路有一段时间了。长途驾驶和在世界上孤独地行走是她的第二天性。新鲜的是她对鲜血的渴望与日俱增，以及永生的遥远威胁。现在，早晨带来的不仅仅是新一天的曙光，还带来了她无法摆脱的恐惧感。

在与对未来的恐惧作斗争时，安吉尔在高速公路加油站意外遇到了一位陷入自己麻烦的火热陌生人 - 这次偶然的相遇可能会让安吉尔走上一条全新的道路。

[来自[url=https://docilesmiles.itch.io/on-the-horizon]itch.io[/url]]
